confidential_elements.confidentiality_details: Every data type is listed with controlled access. OMOP and telemetry data sit in the enclave; clinical notes are not placed in the enclave but stored locally at contributing sites, with only tokens shared.

is_deidentified.method: Extraction and tokenization of unstructured EHR text with the OHNLP toolkit; de-identification of imaging, in process for the larger cohort as of September 2025; transformation of data using approaches that limit re-identification.
is_deidentified.deidentification_details: De-identification is combined with controlled access rather than relied on alone: users are granted access to a provisioned environment after registration and a signed licensing agreement. Identifiable source material remains at the contributing sites, where clinical note text is stored locally and only tokens are shared.
